name: SL-651,498
summary: SL651498 is an anxiolytic and anticonvulsant drug used in scientific research, with a chemical structure most closely related to β-carboline derivatives such as abecarnil and gedocarnil. It has similar effects to benzodiazepine drugs, but is structurally distinct and so is classed as a nonbenzodiazepine anxiolytic.

pharmacology.text: SL651498 is a subtype-selective GABAA agonist, which acts as a full agonist at α2 and α3 subtypes, and as a partial agonist at α1 and α5 (although its action at α5 subtypes is much weaker than at the others). When given repeatedly it failed to produce tolerance or dependence, probably due to its low affinity and efficacy at the α5 subtype.

uses.text: SL651498 is an anxiolytic and anticonvulsant drug used in scientific research, with a chemical structure most closely related to β-carboline derivatives such as abecarnil and gedocarnil.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. In animals it produced little tolerance or dependence with repeated use. Drugs acting at the benzodiazepine site can still cause drowsiness and poor coordination.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。在動物實驗中，重複使用後幾乎不產生耐受性或依賴。作用於苯二氮平結合位的藥物仍可能造成嗜睡與協調變差。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。在动物实验中，重复使用后几乎不产生耐受性或依赖。作用于苯二氮平结合位的药物仍可能造成嗜睡与协调制差。

fact.en: Although it acts at the same site as benzodiazepines, its chemical structure is closer to the β-carbolines, a family that also includes plant compounds such as harmine.
fact.zh: 雖然它與苯二氮平作用在同一個位置，但它的化學結構更接近β-咔啉類，這個家族也包括駱駝蓬鹼等植物成分。
fact.zhHans: 虽然它与苯二氮平作用在同一个位置，但它的化学结构更接近β-咔啉类，这个家族也包括骆驼蓬碱等植物成分。
